## What I do

I'm a scientist who turns complex technical problems into clear decisions, combining AI/ML-driven image analysis and quantitative modelling with the ability to align specialists across teams.

During my PhD at [IST Austria](https://ista.ac.at/en/home/) in the [Heisenberg](https://heisenberglab.pages.ist.ac.at/) and [Hannezo](https://hannezo.pages.ist.ac.at/) labs, I led a five-year project on a surprisingly open question: how do tissues move as one coordinated whole? I adapted Cellpose, a deep-learning segmentation tool, to decode 40 TB of noisy live-imaging data, built a physical model from the results, and designed an [end-to-end reproducible pipeline](projects/efficiency-pipeline.qmd) that brought together experiments and expertise across biochemistry, biophysics, and soft-matter physics from three institutions. The work, published in [Nature Communications](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-72366-z), showed how different parts of cells' internal skeletons interact to coordinate movement across embryonic tissues, with implications for wound healing, cancer, and genetic skin disorders such as epidermolysis bullosa. Along the way, it helped secure **€500K+ in research funding**, and I trained **10+ early-career researchers** in microscopy and data analysis.

After my PhD, I spent a year as IST Austria's **Image Analysis Expert**, advising **500+ researchers** on analysis pipelines and leading the zero-disruption migration of **60+ microscopy workstations** across imaging, IT, and cybersecurity teams.

Outside the lab, I joined [PhD Balance](https://www.phdbalance.com/), a global volunteer network building tools and conversations around mental health in academia, during a period when I was working through my own mental-health challenges. Helping others through the same struggles turned out to be one of the things that helped me most. For two years I led its social-media team of five, setting the content strategy and running campaigns that helped grow the community to **25,000 followers**. I also co-founded two international academic seminar series that ran **100+ sessions across four years**. Both of these communities were built through shared enthusiasm rather than formal authority or dedicated resources.

I&rsquo;m now looking for roles in deep-tech startups and life-science consulting, where I can help teams move from messy data and uncertainty to clear next steps.

### [6 Hours to Fully Reproduce 5 Years of Research — The Efficiency System Behind It](projects/efficiency-pipeline.qmd)
How I built an end-to-end analysis pipeline that condensed 40 TB of PhD data into 12 fully reproducible figures. The real stress-test: the day before my defence, I wanted a new colour scheme for my slides — so I regenerated every figure in the paper in a single afternoon. The system held.
